entry.title: Al Hamra Tower
entry.note: Fresh OSM API on 2026-10-10 confirms exact Q557933 whole way 188381326; independently retained map-parts geometry is unchanged. Signed heading -0.16301785935 puts native +X east-southeast, +Z south-southwest and -Z north-northeast. Architectural Record printed page 152 site/lobby plans with north arrows independently establish the northern entry, southern shopping mall and eastern parking block. Printed page 150 sections establish the courtyard moving southwest at grade to southeast near the top; a coarse whole rectangle is not the occupied floor shape. Native Y=0 is reconstructed street entry; no measured local grade. Accept 2 m footprint / 1 degree reconstruction allowance; automatic replacement disabled. Separate shopping mall, parking block, neighbouring towers and road grade are outside this tower scope. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
